module.title: Phantom - stellar winds, particle injection, accretion boundaries and sink feedback
module.expensive_path: inject_particles + the SPH force/density loop it feeds: for setup_wind.f90 the cost is dominated by the 1D wind ODE solve in wind.F90 at t=0 (serial, ~10^2 steps) plus the per-step SPH derivative evaluation over the growing particle set; for BHL/windtunnel/masstransfer the cost is the SPH derivative evaluation over a monotonically growing particle count (the injection boundary adds thousands of particles per dtmax), so wall time grows superlinearly with the evolved window.
module.rationale: Phantom's swappable SRCINJECT interface (init_inject / inject_particles / update_injected_par, wrapped by src/main/injection.f90) is one code path shared by 17 injection modules; it is the natural port unit because every one of these setups compiles a different inject_*.f90 against the same interface and the same partinject.f90 particle-creation machinery. The stellar-wind family (setup_wind.f90 -> wind/isowind/mhdwind/ismwind/radwind) additionally owns the 1D wind ODE integrator (wind.F90 + wind_equations.f90), the dust nucleation / Bowen opacity chemistry (dust_formation.f90) and sink radiative acceleration (ptmass_radiation.f90), which nothing outside the wind family uses. Phantom's own numerical test for this area, src/tests/test_wind.f90, is run by upstream CI in four compile modes and is the only unit test that exercises injection end to end.
excluded: SETUP=grbondi-inject and inject_bondi.f90 under GR (METRIC=schwarzschild) - relativity worker
disc physics reached by randomwind / boilingplanets / streamerdisc / exoALMA / isosgstream (setup_disc.f90, analysis_disc.f90, disc viscosity) - disc worker owns the disc; only the injector is ours
SETUP=jet (setup_sphereinbox.f90): no injection module at all, it is an MHD sphere-in-box collapse - MHD/self-gravity worker
SETUP=balsarakim beyond inject_sne.f90: MHD + H2 chemistry + periodic boundaries - claimed in parallel by the radiation/thermochemistry worker
dust growth in discs, radiation FLD, pure hydro and MHD shock tests
hazards: make -j is broken upstream (build/.depends is empty): every build must be serial and one goal per make invocation

the 1D wind ODE in wind.F90 is exponentially ill-conditioned on the supersonic branch: a 2-ulp change in the sink mass grows to 1e-3 relative in the profile and 4e-2 in the evolved dump. The variant IC for the wind family must be the mass-loss rate (density-only), not the sink mass/luminosity/Teff/Reff
evolved dumps differ between OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and 2 at ~1e-14 relative (injection ordering + OpenMP reductions); OMP_NUM_THREADS must be pinned by the check
every dump's 100-char fileident (bytes 0x24-0x87) carries a wall-clock timestamp, so whole-file cmp always fails; compare parsed arrays
default nfulldump=10 makes intermediate dumps single precision; set nfulldump=1
phantom/phantomsetup allocate maxp_alloc=5200000 particles (~5 GB) whenever the build has injection; --maxp=200000 cuts this to 199 MB and is bit-neutral
phantom rewrites the .in file after every full dump (dumpfile= points at the last dump), so a re-run must restore the .in
inject_randomwind.f90, inject_galcen_winds.f90 and inject_streamer_pineda.f90 draw random numbers (ran2) with fixed seeds; galcen's seed is the module constant iseed=-666

SETUP=galcen reads data/galcen/stars.m.pos.-vel.txt and data/galcen/winddata.txt through find_phantom_datafile, which curls the file from Zenodo when it is missing and PHANTOM_DIR is unset; those two files ARE present in this checkout, but data/velfield, data/forcing and data/eos/* are empty and would trigger a network fetch
dust nucleation and Bowen opacity need no external tables: all coefficients are hard-coded in dust_formation.f90
the wind unit test is skipped entirely under MPI (test_wind.f90:52) and under any build without the wind injection module

find_datafile declares env_dir and mydir as character(len=120) (src/main/utils_datafiles.f90:37), so a PHANTOM_DIR longer than 120 characters is silently truncated and the data lookup fails with a confusing message; SETUP=galcen died this way in my scratch tree. Stage data files into the run directory instead of relying on PHANTOM_DIR

SETUP=asteroidwind cannot be evolved at all with default answers: it FATALs with 'densityiterate: could not converge in density on particle 1' at tmax = 2 dtmax, and its nmax=0 dump contains zero gas particles
one check per SETUP means one full serial rebuild per check (80-260 s); the 900 s suite budget caps this module at about five or six distinct SETUPs
